A little note

Just for you.

Heeru,

Nine months, and I still smile like a fool every time I see you. Your smile, your cuteness, your childish side, your big dreams and the way you chase them. I love every bit of it.

I love how much you care for everybody around you, how responsible you are, and how you cook the most delicious food. You make everything feel easy and warm.

Thank you for every ride, every date, every plate of paani poori, and every little moment that doesn’t even have a name. Here’s to all the months ahead.

Love always,
